blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Tacloban City employees have asked Mayor Alfred Romualdez to temporarily suspend the city government’s weekly flag-raising ceremony due to extreme heat amid the prevailing El Niño. In an endorsement dated Oct. 5 and received by the City Mayor’s Office on Oct. 6, the Government Association of Tacloban Employees (GATE) said unusually high temperatures and prolonged heat could pose health and safety risks to city government employees and other personnel who are required to stay outdoors during the ceremony. The request was coursed through City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office Department Head Ildebrando Bernadas. READ: Drought forecast to […]...
